hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */backend/*) d="${f%%/backend/*}/backend";; */frontend/*) d="${f%%/frontend/*}/frontend";; *) exit 0;; esac; (cd "$d" && npx --no-install prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"); } 2>/dev/null || true
